title: Chori Chori Chupke Chupke
desc: Raj and Priya hire Madhubala as a surrogate. But when Madhubala falls for Raj and claims the child as her own, love, betrayal, and chaos turn their lives upside down.

title: Barsaat (1995)
desc: Badal likes his classmate Tina, but her father disapproves. The father falsely gets him arrested, trying to end their relationship before it goes any further.

title: Daulat Ki Jung
desc: Rajesh and Asha elope because their rival business families oppose their love. However, they become entangled with two rival groups searching for a hidden tribal treasure.

title: Bade Miyan Chote Miyan
desc: Arjun and Pyare, two cops from the same station, are wrongly accused of multiple crimes. Their probe reveals the real offenders are their own lookalike impostors.

title: Main Khiladi Tu Anari
desc: Inspector Karan seeks justice for his brother Arjun's murder. But Deepak, an actor, complicates things by shadowing him to add realism to his role.

title: Kick
desc: Devi, addicted to adventures, breaks up with Shaina, a psychiatrist in Warsaw. His daredevil pursuits test love, freedom, and the cost of chasing thrill over stability.

title: Tigers : Can A Salesman Be A Hero
desc: A pharma salesman in Pakistan takes on his own company after discovering they knowingly marketed harmful baby formula, risking everything to expose the truth.

title: Bhoot Returns
desc: Tarun and Namrata move into a luxurious bungalow with their children, Taman and Nimmi. But mysterious events soon threaten their lives, forcing them to escape for survival.

title: Kanyadaan
desc: Married as children, Rekha and Amar are separated by fate. Years later, shocking truths emerge as Rekha discovers Amar's new marriage and Kumar's hidden identity.

title: Andaz Apna Apna
desc: Amar and Prem are broke dreamers chasing the same rich heiress, Raveena, but their silly feud gets wildly out of hand after crossing paths with dangerous gangster Teja.

title: Ram Lakhan
desc: Ram, a righteous cop, and Lakhan, his carefree brother, unite for revenge after discovering their father was murdered by two cunning criminals. Justice, drama, and brotherhood drive their journey.

title: Biwi No. 1
desc: Pooja, a loving wife, is devastated when her husband Prem falls for model Rupali. With support from friends, she confidently takes charge, making Prem realize her true worth.

title: Khalnayak
desc: Inspector Ram arrests notorious criminal Ballu, but when Ballu escapes and ruins Ram's reputation, his fiancee Ganga sets a trap-only to face trouble when Ballu unexpectedly falls for her.

title: Mass Jathara
desc: An honest railway cop is transferred to a small town. He fights to bring down a smuggling network run by a powerful drug lord.

title: Dream Girl
desc: Karamveer lands a call-center job thanks to his knack for mimicking a woman's voice. Fame follows, but trouble brews as obsessed clients push him into dangerous territory.
